forecast-period.text: A series of troughs over SA will slowly move east ahead of a high pressure system that moves into the Bight on Friday. A cold front moving across the Southern Ocean will clip the far southeast late today, with a low pressure system developing near the Victorian border on Friday. Another trough near the WA border is expected to develop on Saturday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Showers and isolated thunderstorms possible across most districts, but remaining dry in the far northeast, tending to rain at times over parts of the agricultural areas. Possible severe thunderstorms in western and central districts. Maximum temperatures below average in the west and south but above average in the northeast. Fresh and gusty north to northwesterly winds in the northeast ahead of a southwest to southeasterly change extending across all but the far northeast corner.

Isolated morning showers and thunderstorms over the pastoral districts, becoming less likely during the day. Isolated showers about the southern agricultural area, contracting to he southeast during the afternoon. Maximum temperatures below average. South to southeasterly winds, fresh near the coast and in the north during the afternoon.

Isolated showers and thunderstorms over the far west. Isolated showers about the southeast, clearing during the evening. Maximum temperatures below average. Southeasterly winds, fresh near the southeast coast.

text.p: Isolated showers and thunderstorms over the far west, extending into central districts during the day. Maximum temperatures below average. Southeast to northeasterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: 2 to 5 mm across the North East Pastoral district. 5 to 15 mm is expected elsewhere across the state, reaching 15 to 30 mm in the northwest and across the southern agricultural area.
